description: Paced sustainable links and page-latency histograms per series (f_s, page target, N, R, F), server plan of 9 series on a quiet Linux host; headless paced runs (in-process TX generators, RX kept in the engine, no transport, no client process, no control socket: an engine-alone upper bound); copied unchanged

data_class_notes.MEAS: paced timing on the stated Linux host (DESIGN 12.3: paced numbers only from Linux)

run.sustainable_rule: miss rate < 1e-3 at 1 ms slack, late_samples == 0, overflow_pages == 0 over the measured window, every repetition (DESIGN 12.1)
run.stopping_rule: L is doubled while every repetition is Sustainable; the first unsustainable repetition ends the point and the series, so the last point of a series may have 1 or 2 repetitions
run.render: headless paced engines keep the parallel render driver threshold render_numba.PARALLEL_MIN_WORK (points.csv render_min_work = 65536); threading_layer omp

host.region: ap-south-1 (inferred from the apt mirror in the job log, not recorded by the manifests)
host.os: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws, #14~24.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT Fri Sep 18 21:24:59 UTC 2026)

launch.cmd: export SREMU_GIT_COMMIT=bf0826812891043b8ce5d76acb9595d06307d4c4 SREMU_GIT_DIRTY=0; bash bench/aws/job.sh b3 --deadline-min 180; echo JOB_EXIT=$?; python -m bench.summarize --root $SREMU_JOB_OUT/runs --out $SREMU_JOB_OUT/bench_summary.json; echo SUM_EXIT=$?

sremu.commit_source: SREMU_GIT_COMMIT / SREMU_GIT_DIRTY=0 exported by the AWS job (host/job_stdout.txt line 1; launches.jsonl); manifests record git_dirty false

supersedes: 20261011T074437Z_b3_server (309c633) and the B3 runs at 4ec4c2b and 81f2735 (not in the paper tree; research/aws/results)
caveats: miss_rate_0ms = 1.0 everywhere by construction: a page is released for computation at R_j, so it can never be delivered by R_j + 0; the miss rate at slack s is the CCDF of the page latency.
Headless: client, transport and control-socket costs are not included.
L is doubled while Sustainable; the first unsustainable repetition ends the point and the series (the F3 series has one repetition in total; several end points have one or two).
Mobility (F3) was tried only at 0.512 ms pages, N = 240, one link.
Page latency histograms are log-linear (1 us resolution, 1/64 relative bucket width).
